_comment: Client sites shown on the managed-hosting board (assets/os-hosting.svg).
EDIT THIS FILE, then run: python3 tools/gen_status_board.py
Only put a site here once the client is happy to be named publicly.
Fields stack/host/tls/live describe verifiable facts about the deployment.
uptime and response are OPTIONAL and omitted by default on purpose: this
board is a static SVG and nothing is polled, so a hard-coded '99.98%' next
to a real client's domain would be an unverifiable public claim about your
service. Add them only when you have real figures you're happy to stand behind.
